and then step into the shader side. this is also just booty. idont know if thats obvious from the code or not but holy shit man i cant tell you how many times ive been making my way downtown walking fast and i somehow slip a minutia of pixel space when still trying to get to the last sets of pages and bom closes the component, reset to page 1. 2ndly, lets say i make it all the way down to the page i want. nice. now i pick one, and the next color /shader pick is back at page one baby, even if the one 28 pages down is highlighted as the active in state choice. 

also, the component visually is a warcrime for that every single page i navigate through here is giving me different content delivery height, and then the audacity it has to not even fill in a page in full is gonna make me roll over in my grave really. what its doing something like 15 per page, so you would think ah yeah thats 3 rows of 5 or 5 of 3, nope its 2 of 5 1 of 1 and 1 of 4, then the next page is 3 of 5 then the next is 1 of 2 2 of 5 1 of 3 and buddy we are only 3 pages in and we cant make up our minds makes me goi insane. and one of the main reasons is that it fucking just blows. then the dead space / empty space shit and the variant badges or pills or buttons or whatever they are versus idk maybe something that is more sane like just showing me the 3 varients so i dont have to go navigating through each one and ultimately missing by a fucking iota of a pixel and have the menu close
resolution: Completed a read-only code trace of the active Color/Shader Ink popover after the user's interaction report. Confirmed the close-on-miss behavior: a full-screen close Pressable sits beneath a visible panel whose root Box does not block pointer hits, so blank pixels and gaps inside the panel fall through to close; shader page arrows are only 24x22 hit islands. Confirmed the color map sends every uncoalesced native pointer-motion event into top-level AppFrame state, triggering a whole editor render and whole-state hot-state JSON serialization; color-to-brush reconciliation then updates ModelView, whose tool snapshot writes back to AppFrame for another render/persist cycle. Confirmed nine color-choice paths are composed at once: hex, transient hard-coded Saved defaults, map, chroma strip, Fits, Ramp, hard-coded Pigments, fake hard-coded Scene colors, and hard-coded Sets. Saved is not cold-persistent user data; Scene does not inspect the scene; extreme neutral colors are mislabeled because oklchName ignores chroma and has no white/black cases. The OKLCH map hard-clamps out-of-gamut RGB channels, producing the visible geometric clipping. Confirmed shader pagination always initializes page 0, never locates the active shader, slices 15 flat entries then re-groups them into category shelves, causing ragged rows, shifting heights, and dead space; active variants are text pills rather than visible variant choices. No focused tests cover this UI. No source files changed. Recommended consolidation keeps hex, a performant settled/live-preview color field, and the ramp as core; treats Fits/Pigments as unproven; removes fake Saved/Scene/Sets until backed by real user/project/scene data; and replaces the shader shelf pager with a fixed-size, persistent, active-aware grid using cached thumbnails and visible variants inside the one canonical paint bucket.
